title: Gift Idea to Purchase Conversion for Visits
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=giftbudget:item
| search occasion_type="visit"
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(status="purchased")) as successful by _time visit_name
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for gift ideas for long-distance visits by visit.
value: Conversion from idea to purchase shows whether thoughtful intentions are becoming real gestures in time.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for gift ideas for long-distance visits events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for gift ideas for long-distance visits by visit.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how often gift ideas for long-distance visits works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
